topic.title: Project Review Tasks
topic.shortdesc: Project Review Tasks let authors send Content Fusion project content for review and manage feedback as part of the project workflow.

body.p: A Project Review Task is a review task created from content in a Content Fusion project. It is part of the project workflow and allows accepted changes to be integrated back into the project content.
Authors use Project Review Tasks to collect feedback on project content and manage that feedback in a structured way.

section.title: Why authors use project review tasks

ul.li: To share project content with reviewers.
To collect comments and suggestions in one place.
To keep review work connected to the project workflow.
To integrate accepted feedback back into the project content.

section.title: What authors manage
section.p: Authors can create tasks, control access, monitor discussions, and process the feedback that reviewers provide. They can then integrate accepted changes back into the project content. This makes Project Review Tasks a central part of collaborative authoring.
